## About
MEITEC provides electrical and instrumentation construction services to energy markets, including drilling, pipeline, production, marine and power, both domestic and international. Our motto is "a construction company with a service company mentality."
Executive management, Ross Bubrig and Tom Isbell, have worked together in electrical and instrumentation construction for decades and remain intimately involved in all aspects of the company. Ross, our President, is an Electrical Engineer who started as an electrician's helper in the field. Michael Bubrig, Vice President of Projects, has direct responsibility for all projects.
We provide project management and support from project inception to completion, adapting to specific customer and project needs. Customers rate us 4.3 from 50 Google reviews.

## Services
- Drilling: Electrical and instrumentation construction for drilling.
- Production: Electrical and instrumentation construction for production.
- Pipeline: Electrical and instrumentation construction for pipeline work.
- Industrial: Electrical and instrumentation services for industrial customers.
- Marine: Electrical and instrumentation construction for marine work.
- Buildings: Electrical and instrumentation services for buildings.
- Power Barges: Electrical and instrumentation services for power barges.
- Terminals: Electrical and instrumentation services for terminals.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work outside the Houston area?
A: Yes. Our crews and project managers can be mobilized throughout the world.

Q: How involved are you over the life of a project?
A: We provide project management and support from project inception to completion, with the flexibility to adapt to specific customer and project needs.

Q: Where is your office and when is it open?
A: Our Houston office is at 4107 New West Drive in Pasadena, TX, open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We also have a New Orleans office in Metairie, LA.
